scope: Independent inspection of the saved desktop and narrow large-text/high-contrast View chooser captures, plus read-only native fixture assumptions.

observations: Four outer groups remain easy to scan, with clear separation between Accessibility, Specimen display, Lighting and motion, and Workspace actions.
The four specimen subgroups separate anatomy/presentation, local inspection, scene cues, and saved-frame reference controls. Native controls retain their original sequence.
Selected toggles use a thick border, underline, filled status dot, and pale fill. Unselected toggles keep a hollow dot.
The selected saved frame and its source layer are visible above Split compare. Pin prerequisites and technique-display effects sit next to their relevant controls.
No text or control clipping is visible. The illumination control makes its label, percentage, and slider readable.
All four specimen subgroups and their controls stack in one column at 320 pixels. Headings and purpose text remain associated with their controls.
High-contrast selected states retain thick borders, underlines, and filled status dots; differences remain apparent without color.
Long descriptions wrap fully, including the saved-frame layer and technique-display explanation. No horizontal clipping is visible.
Larger text makes the panel taller, while all controls remain fully available and readable.

nativeFixtureFinding.case: native practical hides inspection and reference actions and guards labels until End restores the View chooser
nativeFixtureFinding.finding: The native timed-practical start closes View by setting toolbarViewOpen false. The original fixture queried its controls without reopening it.
nativeFixtureFinding.correction: Assert View closes after Start. Open the native Accessibility options toggle to inspect assessment controls. Open #diss-route-study to return to the End control, end the practical, and open View and accessibility options to inspect restored controls.
nativeFixtureFinding.status: Reported promptly to root; no fixture or runtime files edited during the active run.

validationLimit: Visual findings apply to the two saved captures inspected here. The root runner records the complete automated results separately.
